description.value: The Keefer Bar is an apothecary-inspired cocktail bar located in the heart of Vancouver's historic Chinatown, recognized as the 2nd best bar in Canada three years running. It offers a menu of over 25 unique handcrafted cocktails drawing on fresh herbs, exotic spices, and homemade concoctions in a dark, moody atmosphere. It is a liquor-primary venue for guests 19 and older, making it a distinctive evening destination for cyclists exploring the city.
